Done. Summary:

- `out/T4/solution.py`: standalone PyTorch/safetensors script that (1) loads base/ft1/ft2, verifies identical key sets and 160 tensors, identifies the 48 MLP tensors by name pattern, verifies the other 112 are bit-exact identical across all three checkpoints (base vs ft1 and base vs ft2), aborting loudly otherwise; (2) computes `out[X] = base[X] + λ(ft1[X]-base[X]) + λ(ft2[X]-base[X])` in float32 with λ=0.4 for each of the 48 MLP tensors, using the unmodified base each time (no ordering hazard); (3) copies the other 112 tensors unchanged; (4) asserts exactly 48 merged / 160 total before saving.
- Ran once, succeeded on the first execution, wrote `out/T4/model.safetensors` (160 tensors, 48 merged + 112 unchanged).
- `out/T4/REPORT.md` written with the self-report.
